cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The first two formal start attempts were rejected before line creation: shell-split gate values and a non-normalized tag. The third attempt used normalized identifiers and created the line.
impact: No product file was changed and the formal line was created successfully after correcting the invocation.
lesson: Normalize every formal CLI identifier before starting a line and keep gate values shell-safe.

cause: The new local-first bootstrap test imports the planned version boundary and local authority seams before those seams exist.
impact: The implementation is correctly red before the first code change; no product path is accepted until the typed seams are implemented.
lesson: Keep a focused red test for every authority and version boundary before implementation.

cause: The local-first implementation now binds workflow state, host identity, evidence owner, and Agent/Notebook cutover to the bootstrapped Darwin backend.
lesson: Keep authority, evidence ownership, and Resume scope server-bound before allowing any local execution path.

cause: The restarted local backend and frontend were exercised through the visible Agent, Notebook, and Report UI surfaces using the shared cutover and evidence boundary.

evidence.ref: 127.0.0.1:5179 Agent Notebook Report visible DOM markers after backend restart

lesson: Browser acceptance must verify user-visible trust boundaries after a real backend restart, not only component tests or HTTP status codes.

cause: The focused local-first backend suites, deterministic planner contracts, frontend typecheck, frontend full suite, static cutover scan, and restarted browser acceptance were run as separate evidence classes.

evidence.ref: backend focused suites; frontend npm test -- --run; npm run typecheck; git diff --check; internal browser 127.0.0.1:5179

lesson: Report focused package gates, browser acceptance, provider-backed quality, and release-wide gates as separate claims.

cause: This line deliberately verifies only the current Darwin host. Real external provider quality, Linux, other macOS hosts, cloud deployment, and release merge/tag remain outside the local acceptance boundary; the deterministic baseline also reports unavailable for capabilities without a local fixture.
lesson: Do not convert a local Darwin safety result or deterministic evaluator result into an external-host or real-provider claim.

cause: The release-wide full gate remains red. The first reproducible failure is the historical v1.8.6 Agent statistical-evidence test writing a bare statistical_tests/evidence.json without a server-owned evidence owner, receipt, or projection binding, then expecting it to be trusted.
impact: The new local-first focused gates and browser acceptance remain green, but the worktree is not release-ready until stale legacy assertions are migrated or explicitly retired and the full suite is re-audited.
lesson: A clean cutover must update legacy consumer tests to exercise the canonical server-owned evidence path; never restore a raw artifact fallback merely to make the old assertion pass.

cause: After migrating the first legacy raw-evidence assertion, the next five release-suite failures are v1.8.7 tests that call Agent result projection without a server-owned evidence owner and still expect legacy model-result and survey sections.
impact: The new central evidence consumer and local owner path remain covered by v1.8.9 tests, but the historical v1.8.7 direct-helper suite must be migrated to that owner path or explicitly retired before the release-wide gate can be green.
lesson: Do not make an unconfigured direct helper silently bootstrap or trust evidence; migrate historical consumer tests to the explicit host-owned fixture and keep unavailable states typed.

cause: The local example completed model fitting and evidence production but the Report projection schema gate rejected admission.
impact: The run is correctly failed closed; Notebook and Agent cannot execute the unbound post-estimation capability, and Report has no citable facts.
lesson: A persisted evidence packet is not a passed Report projection; keep model output, evidence admission, and consumer projection as separate gates.
